basic_profile.bio: Hi there! I'm a 21-year-old from Seattle, currently navigating my way through college life while juggling my passion for gaming and music. I've recently dipped my toes into PC gaming, although I've been an Xbox enthusiast for a couple of years now. Music is a big part of my life, with a particular fondness for alternative and emo bands like Citizen and Turnover. I'm also venturing into the world of anime, having started with Death Note. When I'm not gaming or exploring new music, I'm usually hanging out at local cafes or hiking nearby trails. I typically browse Reddit in the evenings after classes and on weekends. I'm single and enjoy connecting with like-minded individuals online.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge in gaming stems from years of playing on multiple platforms, starting with consoles and transitioning to PC gaming. I keep up with the latest gaming news via forums and YouTube channels. My music taste is eclectic, shaped by years of attending local gigs and following music blogs. As for anime, I'm a newbie, learning through recommendations from friends and online communities.
